summary: 7/7 acceptance criteria exercised for the new auth/cards feature set. 3 new backend pytest files (8 test cases, all passed) + 3 pre-existing backend files repaired to authenticate (now 14/14 passed total) + 7 new named browser checks (all passed, one re-run through APP_URL ingress). No bugs found; the reported Nubank card click works end-to-end.

checks.name: login-blocks-unauthenticated-access
checks.evidence: Navigating directly to '/' and to '/cartoes' without a session both redirect to login-page (data-testid=login-page); the two guarded API calls returned 401 as expected (visible as console 401 entries, not app errors).

checks.name: test_tscheck_protecao_paginas_financeiras.py
checks.evidence: GET /api/finance/summary, /api/finance/cards, /api/finance/cards/card-nubank without cookie -> 401 for all three.

checks.name: login-invalid-credentials-shows-generic-error
checks.evidence: Unknown email and correct-email/wrong-password both keep the user on login-page and show login-error-message with the generic text 'E-mail ou senha incorretos.' (no field-specific hint).

checks.name: test_tscheck_login_invalido_e_valido.py
checks.evidence: POST /api/auth/login with wrong password -> 401 {detail:'E-mail ou senha incorretos'}, no cash_session cookie set; unknown email -> 401, no cookie; correct credentials -> 200 with cash_session cookie set.

checks.name: owner-login-opens-financial-dashboard
checks.evidence: Logging in with proprietario@cash.app / Cash@2026! reveals home-page with saldo-livre-real-value, and the cash_session browser cookie is present and flagged HttpOnly. Re-ran successfully through APP_URL https://responsive-expo.preview.emergentagent.com.

checks.criterion: Acesso ao cartão Nubank reportado pelo usuário
checks.name: accounts-nubank-card-opens-details
checks.evidence: On the Contas page, card-summary-open-card-nubank is visible and clickable; clicking navigates to /cartoes/card-nubank and renders card-details-page with card-details-name = 'Nubank' (no blank screen or error).

checks.name: card-details-shows-invoice-and-linked-accounts
checks.evidence: card-details-number contains '4821', card-details-limit contains '8.000', closing/due show 3/12, current-invoice-value and next-invoice-value render, and linked accounts include card-account-name-rec-notebook='Notebook' and card-account-name-rec-streaming='Streaming de vídeo'.

checks.name: test_tscheck_detalhes_fatura_nubank.py
checks.evidence: GET /api/finance/cards/card-nubank -> 200 with last_four=4821, limit=8000.0, closing_day=3, due_day=12, current_invoice/next_invoice present, accounts list contains 'Notebook' and 'Streaming de vídeo'. Unknown card id -> 404.

checks.name: cards-nav-lists-and-opens-nubank-invoice
checks.evidence: nav-cards opens cards-page listing cards-list-item-card-nubank; clicking open-card-card-nubank ('Abrir fatura') lands on the same card-details-page with card-details-name='Nubank'.

checks.name: logout-ends-session-and-requires-relogin
checks.evidence: sidebar-logout-button click clears session and returns to login-page; a subsequent direct navigation to /cartoes also redirects to login-page, proving the session was actually invalidated.

notes: Matrix has 7 criteria; 10 artifacts were produced (3 criteria are API-backed UI flows and got both a browser check and a backend test file).

Repaired 3 pre-existing backend test files from iteration 1 (test_tscheck_contas_pagamento_mensal.py, test_tscheck_dashboard_financeiro_mensal.py, test_tscheck_lancamento_manual.py) that started failing with 401 once auth was added to /api/finance/* routes; added a shared `auth_client` fixture in conftest.py and switched those tests to use it. Full suite now 14/14 passing.
Onboarding overlay (localStorage cash-onboarding-seen) is explicitly pre-set/skipped in checks that need direct dashboard access, per the briefing's note that it may appear after first login.
form_factor is desktop; all checks ran at the tool's default 1280x720 viewport.
Fixture discipline: no seeded rows were mutated by any of the new checks (pure navigation/auth flows, read-only against card-nubank).
